summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn, Task.finished_time capture/clear logic, the progress.elapsed default style, Palette.__rich__, a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry, tests/test_palette.py, a new test_time_elapsed_column unit test, and the test_columns column-list addition with a hand-traced expected output. Nothing was run: the test suite was not executed, so test_columns and the new tests are unverified. The expected output was derived by tracing the mock clock reads by hand; bar widths were checked with grep. Other tests (test_render, test_track, test_progress_track) were reviewed by reading and should be unaffected. BarColumn was intentionally left unchanged, so its styling still keys off completed versus total rather than task.finished. Nothing is committed.
